t: This is the Warburg Institute, a research centre in central London, part of the University of London's School of Advanced Study. It studies cultural history and the role of images in culture, including how art and science relate to superstition, magic and popular belief. It was founded by Aby Warburg, a German art historian and cultural theorist. He began a private library in Germany, and that library later moved here to London. At its heart was his research into how the classical world lived on in Western culture through to the Renaissance.
